updates.title: What's new
updates.keyboard: Keyboard navigation: skip straight to the calculator, keep focus inside open dialogs, and return to the opener with Escape.
updates.translations: Translate the Modern interface, game names, labels and skill descriptions in one Excel workbook. Upload it to GitHub to publish an update.
updates.builds: Search compatible equipment and Souls, save named builds locally, and compare their calculated stats without changing your current character.
updates.offline: Install the site or use Modern and Legacy modes offline after the first successful load. Save your work before accepting an update.
updates.preservation: The Legacy 2.00 engine remains the calculation source. This is an unofficial community project. Build storage is local to this browser.
builds.shareManual: Copy the link below to share your build.

skills.help: Adeptness uses Skill points. Potential uses its own point pool beside Level. Limits and costs follow the Legacy engine.
skills.listDisabled: The skill list is switched off. Enable it to show available and learned skills.
builds.legacyHelp: Copy old FILE slots into named builds. Originals stay untouched; duplicate codes are skipped.

builds.legacyFailed: FILE recovery failed ({code}). Originals and current build were kept.
builds.catalogHelp: Updates only this character to the published catalog. Equipped items, Souls and effects are checked; named builds keep their original revision.
builds.catalogCurrent: This catalog is already current. No build or save was changed.
builds.catalogApplied: Catalog {revision} applied. Named builds keep their original revision.
builds.catalogUnsaved: Catalog {revision} applied, but autosave failed. Export the current code before leaving; the old save was kept.
builds.catalogUrlWarning: Catalog {revision} applied, but the old shared link could not be cleared. Export a new code or link before reloading.
builds.catalogUnavailable: Could not check the published catalog. Current build and saves kept; try again online.
builds.catalogCancelled: Update cancelled: the character or link changed. Try again for the current build.
builds.catalogProtected: Restore or export the protected autosave first. It was not replaced.
builds.catalogIncompatible: Update incompatible with equipped items, Soul slots or class requirements. Current build and saves kept.
builds.catalogCalculationFailed: Recalculation failed. The previous catalog, character and saves were restored.
builds.catalogRestorationFailed: Recalculation failed and restoration could not be verified. Autosave is paused; reload to recover the untouched saved build.
builds.urlWarning: Build loaded, but the old shared link could not be cleared. Export a new code or link before reloading.
builds.loadCancelled: Loading cancelled. Current character and saved builds kept.
builds.loadUnavailable: Catalog revision unavailable; current character and saved builds kept.
